scripts.dev:api: GUEST_DEV=1 BROKER_URL=http://localhost:8081 npm run dev --workspace api
scripts.dev:broker: GUEST_DEV=1 PORT=8081 npm --prefix ha-broker run dev
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm --prefix ha-broker test
scripts.test:par: concurrently -n api,app,shared,broker -c green,blue,cyan,magenta "npm test -w api" "npm test -w app" "npm test -w shared" "npm --prefix ha-broker test"
